analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are investigating whether [product_name] software can manage time-based changes in analog output (AQ) for controlling a pellet boiler, according to a set time-value curve. The main discussion is about whether the tool supports both sudden and interpolated transitions in AQ. Users are navigating both technical challenges and language barriers, but community support is strong and flexible, showing the tool’s adaptability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to offer configurable time-driven changes in analog output, ideally with options for both stepwise and interpolated adjustments. They also hope for an intuitive way to modify or expand the set of time/value points.
